input.quote: Customer shall be responsible and solely liable for all the Content (including without limitation all intellectual property rights therein) and the Properties.
input.rationale: Nothing assigns Customer IP, Content or data to Kubient, no joint ownership is created, and each Party retains its own marks; Kubient's ownership of the Auction Platform is acceptable. Direction of ownership is therefore correct. We note the Agreement lacks an express "Customer retains all rights in Customer Data" statement, which we would add opportunistically rather than as a redline.
